component.name: Redactor
component.summary: Strips secrets out of text before you paste it anywhere

description.p: Paste a log, a config file or a terminal session. Redactor finds the passwords, API keys, tokens and private keys in it and swaps each one for a placeholder like [REDACTED: Password]. What is left is safe to send to a chat assistant, a ticket or a colleague.

Nothing leaves your machine: there is no network code, no account and no telemetry. The Flatpak has no network permission and no access to your files; files you open or save go through the system's file dialog.
